policy: Hard ceilings for the built playground Worker (apps/playground), minified, every module gzipped one by one. They were fixed on 2026-10-13, before the first measurement (PLAN.md, v0.1, finding H9). Raising one needs a note in an ADR (docs/adr) in the same change. scripts/check-budgets.ts reads this file and fails above a ceiling.

main.reason: The main module, and the chunks it imports statically, are evaluated at every cold start, and the first request of a fresh isolate pays for them: the Free plan gives a request 10 ms of CPU (docs/design.md, risks).

total.reason: Every module is uploaded with the Worker, and the first write loads the lazy ones as well: the Markdown parser is imported on the first write, so what it weighs is the cost of a cold write. Raised from 400 on 2026-10-16 for the structure in D1 (ADR-033): the JSON Schema validator and the operations that change the structure. Cloudflare's own limit is 3 MB on the Free plan.

lazyPackages.reason: Comark parses Markdown on a write and @comark/html renders a stored document. Both load when the first Markdown arrives (ADR-001, ADR-020), so an isolate that only reads or answers a token check never evaluates them.

warmWrite.reason: The Free plan gives a request 10 ms of CPU, and Hollware must run there for a person or an agent alone (ADR-033). The warm write of the 2,027-word fixture is measured from outside, an upper bound of its CPU time, so it holding 10 ms keeps a write within the plan.
